aboutMeText: Full-stack Software Developer and Architect. With 3 years of experience as a freelancer, I specialize in building robust and scalable web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. My work is driven by Clean Architecture and Test-Driven Development (TDD) principles, ensuring code that is both functional and highly maintainable. I currently balance my professional work with my studies in Systems Engineering at UBA. I am a problem-solver at heart and a reliable team player committed to technical excellence from day one.
